verdict.rationale: BVNK publishes extensive public API documentation. It covers Hawk-authenticated API keys, concrete REST endpoints (e.g. POST /payment/v1/rules, POST /payment/v2/payins/simulation, Transfers v3), API-driven wallet creation, webhooks and a sandbox. A probe confirmed a live llms.txt index of the full API docs, which makes the API well suited to programmatic and agent-driven use. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the API works as documented.
